name: Banshee Keen
body:
School conjuration (sonic); Level bard 4, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration see text
Saving Throw Fort half, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You let out a wail of pain and torture. Any creature caught in the cone and fails the Fortitude save suffers 1d6 points of sonic damage per caster level (to a maximum of 15d6) and becomes deafened for 1 round per caster level. Creatures that pass the saving throw takes half damage and are not deafened.
